title: Coast Guard medevacs teen off Ocean City, MD
description: An MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina, medevacs a teen off the cruise ship Norwegian Breakaway off the Maryland coast Monday, June 26, 2017. The teen had reported appendicitis-like symptoms and was accompanied by his grandmother to Sentara Norfolk General Hospital in Norfolk, Virginia. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City/Released)
